page.layout: One column of running text, centred; running head at the top with the page number at the upper right; catchword "tentia" is not a catchword but the end of the last line's word continuation at the foot (printed at right under the last line, so treated as a catchword). A pencilled number in the right margin is handwriting and is omitted.

main_text.p: medium noni seculi temerarium quidem, & quod si dispaluissēt, & Papam, & spem imperii in ipso exortu pessumdedissēt, sed eventu felix: Id consilium fuit fabricare decretales Epistolas Clementis, Anacleti & Episcoporum Romanensium, quibus is modus imperii & potestatis qualem exoptabant in Episcopos Romanos conferebatur: nemine eo seculo quo cusæ sunt & deinceps satis oculato, qui harum Epistolarum fraudes detegeret: non Hincmaris eodem seculo nono, cum Rhemensi, tum Ladunensi: non Arnulfo seu Rhemensi, seu Aurelianensi in causa prioris, illas impostoras pervidentibus: quin postmodum Isidoro, Burchardo, Ivone Carnutensi, Gratiano, Benone, Lombardo, Cajetano, Alfonso de Castro, illas Epistolas pro veris agnoscentibus: Nec per plura secula quisquam in Gallia, Hispania, Germania refragatus est earum authoritati; maximæ sanè (& majoris quam quicquid contra Papæ potestatem vendicatam allegabatur à Patribus & Conciliis) ad mancipandum Papæ, omnem potestatem, omnes Ecclesias, Episcopos, ipsam fidem; si præsupponitur illas Epistolas, vera esse monumenta: Nam hoc posito, quorum testimonio secundum scripturam in negotio fidei, Religionis, disciplinæ habendæ in Ecclesia & usurpatæ in veteri potius standum erit, quam quadraginta & amplius Episcoporum, qui seculis quæ proximè contingunt Apostolos, vixerunt & vitâ, doctrina & martyrio insignes fuerunt, & quorum una & constans sententia

page.notes: The pencilled "285" at the upper right is handwriting and was omitted. Some letters in the scan are blurred (e.g. "Romanensium", "Ivone", "impostoras"), readings are provisional. The word "tentia" at the foot is printed as the continuation of "sententia" and is treated as a catchword.
